description: Shared evaluation contract for the web, Windows and Android price-alert evaluators. Each case is self-contained: build a Map from prices keyed by key, convert trades and rules to the platform models, call evaluatePrices({ now, prices, trades, rules, staleMs }), and compare the complete result with expected.

schema.price: ProviderPrice: key, symbol, provider, price, fetchedAt, sourceTimestamp.
schema.trade: Trade subset used by the evaluator: id, symbol, direction, status, targetPrice, stopPrice, autoClose, binanceSymbol, coingeckoId. Other Trade fields are irrelevant and defaulted by each platform.
schema.rule: PriceAlert subset used by the evaluator: id, kind, symbol, binanceSymbol, coingeckoId, priceMode, level, rangeLow, rangeHigh, percent, percentDirection, repeat, cooldownMinutes, referencePrice, lastPrice, armed, enabled, lastFiredAt. note, createdAt and updatedAt are irrelevant and defaulted.
schema.event: AlertEventDraft with every field: kind, tradeId, ruleId, symbol, price, level, targetPrice, stopPrice, at, provider, status, resolution, readAt.
schema.close: AutoCloseDraft: tradeId, level, reason, at, price.
schema.ruleUpdate: id plus a patch containing only armed, lastPrice, lastFiredAt, enabled and referencePrice.
schema.ordering: events and reviews preserve trade order then rule order; closes preserve trade order; ruleUpdates preserve rule order.
schema.freshness: now - fetchedAt < staleMs is fresh; exactly staleMs is stale.
schema.stale: A stale crossed level emits one stale review with level null and no event or close. Stale takes precedence over gap when both trade levels are crossed. Task 13 dedupes stale reviews by trade/rule and kind.
schema.patches: A rule patch contains only fields whose value changes.
schema.cross-back: Above, below, range and percent re-arm when the condition is no longer true. A crossing rule re-arms on the crossing-back evaluation and does not fire on that evaluation; the next crossing back to the fired side may fire.

cases.name: trade-long-target-auto-close
cases.description: A long trade at its target closes at the exact target when auto-close is on.

cases.name: trade-long-target-no-auto-close
cases.description: A long trade above its target emits a target event and does not close when auto-close is off.

cases.name: trade-long-stop-auto-close
cases.description: A long trade at its stop closes at the exact stop.

cases.name: trade-short-target-auto-close
cases.description: A short trade at its target closes at the exact target.

cases.name: trade-short-stop-auto-close
cases.description: A short trade above its stop closes at the exact stop.

cases.name: trade-no-hit
cases.description: A price between the levels produces no output.

cases.name: trade-both-levels-gap
cases.description: Both levels are hit in one evaluation, so only a gap review is emitted.

cases.name: trade-stale-crossed-target
cases.description: A stale price at the target emits one stale review and never closes.

cases.name: trade-stale-crossed-stop-no-auto-close
cases.description: A stale price at the stop emits one stale review even when auto-close is off.

cases.name: trade-stale-both-levels
cases.description: A stale price that hits both levels emits one stale review with no single level.

cases.name: trade-stale-not-crossed
cases.description: A stale price between the levels is skipped.

cases.name: trade-not-open
cases.description: A closed trade is never evaluated.

cases.name: trade-no-price
cases.description: An open trade with no matching price is skipped.

cases.name: trade-no-levels
cases.description: A trade without a target or stop produces no output.

cases.name: trade-fresh-boundary
cases.description: A price one millisecond younger than staleMs is fresh.

cases.name: trade-coingecko-mapping
cases.description: A CoinGecko-mapped trade resolves its price through the coingecko key.

cases.name: rule-above-fires-once
cases.description: An above rule at the level fires once and is disabled.

cases.name: rule-above-no-fire
cases.description: An above rule below the level only advances lastPrice.

cases.name: rule-above-no-change
cases.description: A no-fire run with an unchanged lastPrice emits no update.

cases.name: rule-below-fires-once
cases.description: A below rule at the level fires once and is disabled.

cases.name: rule-crossing-up-once
cases.description: A crossing rule fires when the price crosses up through the level.

cases.name: rule-crossing-at-level-from-below
cases.description: A crossing rule fires at the level when it came from below.

cases.name: rule-crossing-null-last-price
cases.description: A crossing rule without a last price cannot fire.

cases.name: rule-crossing-same-side
cases.description: A crossing rule does not fire when both prices are above the level.

cases.name: rule-crossing-last-price-at-level
cases.description: A crossing rule needs lastPrice strictly on the other side.

cases.name: rule-crossing-down-once
cases.description: A crossing rule fires when the price crosses down through the level.

cases.name: rule-range-exit-high-once
cases.description: A range rule fires above the inclusive high bound.

cases.name: rule-range-exit-low-once
cases.description: A range rule fires below the inclusive low bound.

cases.name: rule-range-high-boundary-inside
cases.description: The high range bound is inclusive.

cases.name: rule-range-low-boundary-inside
cases.description: The low range bound is inclusive.

cases.name: rule-range-inside
cases.description: A price inside the range does not fire.

cases.name: rule-disabled
cases.description: A disabled rule is skipped even when its condition is true.

cases.name: rule-invalid-configuration
cases.description: Rules with incomplete price or percent settings are skipped.

cases.name: rule-no-mapping
cases.description: A rule without a provider mapping is skipped.

cases.name: rule-no-price
cases.description: A rule with no matching price is skipped.

cases.name: rule-prefers-binance-key
cases.description: A rule with both mappings resolves the Binance key first.

cases.name: rule-stale-crossed
cases.description: A stale price at a crossed level emits a stale review and no update.

cases.name: rule-crossing-stale-crossed
cases.description: A stale crossing emits a stale review.

cases.name: rule-percent-stale-crossed
cases.description: A stale percent move emits a stale review with no level.

cases.name: rule-stale-not-crossed
cases.description: A stale price that does not cross the level is skipped.

cases.name: rule-fresh-boundary
cases.description: A rule price one millisecond younger than staleMs fires.

cases.name: rule-above-cross-back-fires
cases.description: A cross-back rule fires and becomes unarmed.

cases.name: rule-above-cross-back-rearm
cases.description: An unarmed cross-back rule re-arms below the level.

cases.name: rule-above-cross-back-unarmed-still-true
cases.description: An unarmed cross-back rule stays unarmed while the condition is true.

cases.name: rule-above-cross-back-armed-no-fire
cases.description: An armed cross-back rule below the level only advances lastPrice.

cases.name: rule-below-cross-back-rearm
cases.description: An unarmed below cross-back rule re-arms above the level.

cases.name: rule-range-cross-back-rearm
cases.description: An unarmed range cross-back rule re-arms inside the band.

cases.name: rule-crossing-cross-back-rearm
cases.description: An unarmed crossing cross-back rule re-arms on the crossing back to the non-fired side.

cases.name: rule-crossing-cross-back-unarmed-no-fire
cases.description: An unarmed crossing cross-back rule re-arms on a crossing instead of firing.

cases.name: rule-cooldown-never-fired
cases.description: A cooldown rule fires when it has never fired.

cases.name: rule-cooldown-blocked
cases.description: A cooldown rule does not fire before the cooldown elapses.

cases.name: rule-cooldown-one-ms-before-expiry
cases.description: A cooldown rule still waits one millisecond before expiry.

cases.name: rule-cooldown-expired
cases.description: A cooldown rule fires at exactly the cooldown boundary.

cases.name: rule-percent-up-once
cases.description: A percent-up rule fires at its threshold and resets the reference.

cases.name: rule-percent-up-no-fire
cases.description: A percent-up rule below its threshold only advances lastPrice.

cases.name: rule-percent-down-once
cases.description: A percent-down rule fires at its negative threshold and resets the reference.

cases.name: rule-percent-down-no-fire
cases.description: A percent-down rule does not fire on an up move.

cases.name: rule-percent-both-up
cases.description: A percent-both rule fires on a move above the threshold.

cases.name: rule-percent-both-down
cases.description: A percent-both rule fires on a move below the threshold.

cases.name: rule-percent-both-exact
cases.description: A percent-both rule fires at exactly the threshold.

cases.name: rule-percent-both-inside
cases.description: A percent-both rule inside the threshold only advances lastPrice.

cases.name: rule-percent-null-reference
cases.description: A percent rule with no reference is skipped.

cases.name: rule-percent-zero-reference
cases.description: A percent rule with a zero reference is skipped.

cases.name: rule-percent-cross-back-fires
cases.description: A percent cross-back rule fires and resets the reference.

cases.name: rule-percent-cross-back-rearm
cases.description: A percent cross-back rule re-arms when the move is below the threshold.

cases.name: trade-target-only
cases.description: A trade with only a target emits a target event and closes at the target.

cases.name: trade-stop-only
cases.description: A trade with only a stop emits a stop event and closes at the stop.

cases.name: trade-gap-no-auto-close
cases.description: A gap emits a gap review and no close even when auto-close is off.

cases.name: trade-short-gap
cases.description: A short trade with both levels hit emits one gap review.

cases.name: trade-short-stale-crossed
cases.description: A stale short target emits a stale review with level null.

cases.name: rule-below-no-fire
cases.description: A below rule above the level only advances lastPrice.

cases.name: rule-above-fire-unchanged-last-price
cases.description: A fire with an unchanged lastPrice omits lastPrice from the patch.

cases.name: rule-crossing-cross-back-fire-after-rearm
cases.description: A re-armed crossing rule fires on the next crossing back to the fired side.

cases.name: rule-percent-cooldown-blocked
cases.description: A percent cooldown rule does not fire before the cooldown elapses.

cases.name: rule-percent-cooldown-expired
cases.description: A percent cooldown rule fires at the cooldown boundary and resets the reference.

cases.name: rule-stale-cooldown-blocked
cases.description: A stale crossed level emits a stale review even when the cooldown blocks a fire.

cases.name: rule-stale-unarmed-cross-back
cases.description: A stale crossed level emits a stale review even when a cross-back rule is unarmed.

cases.name: mixed-trade-and-rule-events
cases.description: Trade events precede rule events and rule updates follow rule order.

cases.name: mixed-stale-reviews
cases.description: Trade stale reviews precede rule stale reviews.
